name: vm-finance
description: VM-Finance — PWA de finanzas personales multi-usuario (NestJS + Angular)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vm-finance/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @vm-finance/shared" "npm run dev -w @vm-finance/backend" "npm run dev -w @vm-finance/frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build -w @vm-finance/shared && npm run dev -w @vm-finance/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build -w @vm-finance/shared && npm run dev -w @vm-finance/frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vm-finance/shared && npm run build -w @vm-finance/backend && npm run build -w @vm-finance/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w @vm-finance/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vm-finance/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.prepare: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && git config commit.template .gitmessage || true
